title: Allocation of Percentage of HDB Community Care Apartments for Seniors to Suitable Younger Persons with Disabilities
what_it_is: Allocation of Percentage of HDB Community Care Apartments for Seniors to Suitable Younger Persons with Disabilities

sections.label: Community Care Apartments and Enabling Masterplan
sections.summary: CCAs combine senior-friendly design with scalable care services, with two pilots under evaluation, while an Enabling Masterplan 2030 task force studies community living models.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: CCAs integrate senior-friendly design features with care services that can be scaled up as seniors' needs evolve.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The services and activities offered will cater to seniors across a wide range of care needs and enable seniors to age independently in place for as long as they can within the community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We have launched two pilots, which are still under construction, and we will need to evaluate them when they are operational to ensure that they provide sufficient support to the intended target group before we consider expanding the target segment further.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Under the Enabling Masterplan 2030, a task force comprising Government agencies as well as disability social service agencies (SSAs) has been formed to look into community living models and will consider existing gaps as well as new residential options to better support persons with disabilities.
